ratios.quote: The Credit and Guaranty Agreement governing our Credit Facility contains a minimum consolidated fixed charge coverage ratio of 1.20 to 1.00 and a maximum consolidated total net leverage ratio (the “CTNL Ratio”).

ratios.covenant_name: consolidated total net leverage ratio (CTNL Ratio)
ratios.quote: Through September 2027, the CTNL Ratio may not exceed 4.25:1.00; for the period from December 2027 through September 2028, the CTNL Ratio may not exceed 4.00:1.00; and from December 2028 and thereafter, the CTNL Ratio may not exceed 3.75:1.00.

parsed.notes: The filing does not give actual ratio values, only the covenant requirements. The 4.25x net leverage limit applies through September 2027. It then steps down to 4.00x (December 2027–September 2028) and to 3.75x from December 2028 onward. The limit can rise by 0.50x, capped at 4.50x, for four quarters after a qualifying acquisition of $125.0 million or more. Both ratios are tested at each fiscal quarter end. The leverage-based pricing grids for the interest margin and commitment fee are excluded because they only set rates and fees.
